privacy_contact_text: For privacy questions or data deletion requests, contact us at:
privacy_cookies_intro: Katalis uses only strictly necessary cookies required for the service to function. No advertising, analytics, or tracking cookies are used — no cookie consent banner is required.
privacy_cookies_localStorage: Additionally, two browser storage keys (katalis_guest_id and katalis_guest_history) are saved in localStorage — not cookies — to support the guest discovery experience without a server round-trip. These are cleared when browser storage is cleared.
privacy_cookies_rows_0_purpose: Authenticates the logged-in parent or child session. Contains only an encrypted user ID and role — no personal data.
privacy_cookies_rows_1_purpose: Identifies a guest upload session so files can be linked to the correct visitor. Issued only when a guest uploads a file.
privacy_cookies_rows_2_purpose: Remembers the user's selected language (en / id / zh).
privacy_coppa: This platform is designed for children aged 3–12 and complies with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act).
privacy_dataRetention_auditLogs: Action logs are kept for at least 2 years for safety.
privacy_dataRetention_discoveryArtifacts: Discovery artwork and recordings are removed after 1 year.
privacy_dataRetention_interestSignals: Behavioral interest signals are aggregated after 2 years.
privacy_dataRetention_mentorChat: Mentor chat messages are kept for up to 6 months.
privacy_dataRetention_reflections: Reflections and voice recordings are kept for up to 1 year.
privacy_intro: Katalis is committed to protecting the privacy and safety of children. This page explains how we collect, use, and protect data in compliance with COPPA and international child privacy standards.
privacy_noTracking: We do not use advertising trackers or sell any data.
privacy_subtitle: How we protect your child's data
privacy_yourRights_access: Parents can view all data stored about their child.
privacy_yourRights_deletion: Parents can request complete data deletion at any time from the parent dashboard.
privacy_yourRights_sla: Deletion requests are fulfilled within 30 days.
